_comment: CISA baseline checks, PIM for Groups: the eight role policies of pim-alerts-set.json (all set), plus three groups. PRV-T0-GlobalAdmin is eligible for Global Administrator, PRV-T1-ExchangeAdmin holds Exchange Administrator active, and Helpdesk-Tier2 holds Helpdesk Administrator, which isn't one of the eight, so it's out of scope; Dana's eligibility is a user's. Both PRV groups' member policies (notification rules only) send the assignment alerts, and PRV-T0-GlobalAdmin's the activation alert, to secops-alerts@contoso.example. The pass case for PA-PIM-12 and PA-PIM-13. Served by New-PaPimFixtureInvoker; nothing here is a real tenant.
